mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_inventory_return_operation(tenant_id,operation_no,reservation_id,warehouse_id,quantity,request_hash,claim_token) VALUES(#{tenant},#{operation},#{reservation},#{warehouse},#{quantity},#{hash},#{token}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT request_hash,claim_token FROM tc_inventory_return_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_no=#{operation} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_inventory_reservation SET restocked_quantity=restocked_quantity+#{quantity},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{reservation} AND status='CONFIRMED' AND quantity-restocked_quantity>=#{quantity}

UPDATE tc_inventory_balance SET available=available+#{available},sold=sold+#{sold},stock_total=stock_total+#{total},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouse} AND sku_id=#{sku} AND sold>=#{minimumSold}
